text:
marta: FYI I'm going to kick off a repack of the quant kernels for q8 and q4a tonight in the nightwatch window (starting 00:30 UTC). low-risk but want eyes on fallback plan.

deploybot: scheduled: quant-repack-q8-q4a | start=2024-11-14T00:30:00Z | expected-duration=00:45 | runbook=/eng-runtime/playbooks/quant-repack.md :gear:

tj: thanks — what's the pin TTL we should set if we need to sticky older engine?

marta: thinking 2h sticky pin + auto-unpin, unless we see noisy regressions. we can shorten if ops asks.

kai: rolling metrics probe: perf (p95 tokens/ms), mem OOMs, and inference-error-rate. if perf drops >20% or error-rate >0.5% for 3m we abort and pin back.

alisha: add a prompt-regression check for the small eval set (chatty prompts + long-context). can we run before/after diff automatically?

marta: yes — running eval harness pre-deploy. outcome posted to #eng-runtime-postdeploy. snippet: ```./harness/run_eval.py --suite nightwatch-small --baseline=engine:canary-2024-11-12 --candidate=engine:repack-q8q4a```

samir: ops ask: how will rollback look? manual pin or automated fallback to non-quant kernel?

marta: primary rollback: deploybot will unroute canary -> fallback pool with non-quant binary, then we pin the old engine bundle with TTL. steps in runbook: 1) deploybot abort, 2) traffic shift 100% to fallback, 3) pin old bundle, 4) notify customers via status.

deploybot: preflight checks passed: image-signature ok, checksum ok, capacity reserve ok. gating: telemetry hook connected. :white_check_mark:

tj: one more ask — please add release-notes blurb for Dedicated customers: "Quant kernel repack improves memory layout and reduces p95 by ~7-12% on long seqs. Fallback available; see pinned bundles for compatibility."

alisha: added to release notes draft and attached to the bundle PR. also flagged deprecation note for q3-era quant flags.

marta: quick runthrough timeline: 00:00 preflight smoke, 00:15 bake on staging, 00:30 nightwatch start (canary 2% region-eu), 01:00 ramp to 20% if green, 01:30 full roll for night window, 02:30 auto-unpin TTL end. ops oncall @tj @samir pls be ready to ack alerts.

kai: I'll wire up an alert that fires if eval delta > 3% on BLEU-like metric or if latency anomaly on the cluster. will post thresholds in thread.

samir: noted. I'll stand by for first 30m then go to sleepwatch. set pager thresholds to low for this window.

marta: thanks all — will post preflight log and pre-eval results here 23:45 UTC. if anyone wants to join early for dryrun ping me. :rocket:
